name: The Lamp on a Cold Night (Hàn Dạ Đăng)
lore: The first ward lantern Văn Hàn Đăng made, at sixteen in his father's shop at Hồ Khẩu Thôn: birch-bark paper on a pine frame, with the founder's Lantern Ward written inside it. It hung over the lake mouth for twenty winters before he took it down and carried it up to the pavilion. Every lantern of the lake villages is copied from it.
build_use: The head's lantern: sustain and cold resistance for you, and wards that last.

name: Flag of a Hundred Wards (Bách Phù Kỳ)
lore: A flag stitched from the hundred best sheets of birch-bark paper Nhạc Hoa Bì has ever pressed, each with a plain ward on it. She carries it on the paper road to the palace, where Lư Chỉ Mặc of the pines checks every sheet before the wards are written.
build_use: The paper-mistress's flag: faster seals, longer statuses and slowing sheets.

name: Lantern-Maker's Brush (Đăng Tượng Bút)
lore: His father's brush for lantern lettering, a pine-resin tip on a reed. He wrote his first ward with it at sixteen.
build_use: Wards and talismans laid faster and holding longer.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
